description_en: Generates chat responses. You can select a model for the conversation and choose streaming or non-streaming output
description_zh: 对话结果生成，可选择模型进行对话，支持流式和非流式
kebab_example: aliyun dianjin run-chat-result-generation --workspace-id llm-xxxxx --inference-parameters topP=0.8 --messages role=user content=你是一个信息处理专家 --model-id qwen-max --session-id 237645726354 --stream false --tools '[{"function":{"name":"get_time","description":"工具函数的描述","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"unit":{"type":"string","enum":["celsius","fahrenheit"]},"location":{"description":"The_city_and_state,_e.g._San_Francisco,_CA","type":"string"}}},"required":["location"]},"type":"function"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunChatResultGeneration

element_fields.example: 你是一个信息处理专家
element_fields.name: content

parameters.help_en: Messages to input into the model
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: The model service type. Get this value from the /api/app/config API endpoint in the llmHelperTypeList field
parameters.help_zh: 模型服务种类，请通过/api/app/config接口获取，对应的字段llmHelperTypeList
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: Session ID. Use this to mark a conversation
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: Streaming mode. Set to true for streaming responses. Set to false for full responses. Default is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否流式: true，流式返回答案；false，全量返回答案。不填默认为false
parameters.name: stream

fields.help_en: A string describing the tool function. This helps the model decide when and how to call it
fields.help_zh: 类型为string，表示工具函数的描述，供模型选择何时以及如何调用工具函数
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: A string representing the tool function name. It must contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. Maximum length is 64 characters
fields.help_zh: 类型为string，表示工具函数的名称，必须是字母、数字，可以包含下划线和短划线，最大长度为64
fields.name: name
properties

fields.help_en: An object describing the tool parameters. It must be a valid JSON Schema
fields.help_zh: 类型为object，表示工具的参数描述，需要是一个合法的JSON Schema
fields.name: parameters

element_fields.help_en: An object containing name, description, and parameters
element_fields.name: function

element_fields.help_en: A string indicating the tool type. Currently, only "function" is supported
element_fields.help_zh: 类型为string，表示tools的类型，当前仅支持function
element_fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: Tool information. Specify a list of tools the model can call. When multiple tools are provided, the model selects one to generate a response
parameters.help_zh:
输入的工具信息.
用于指定可供模型调用的工具列表。当输入多个工具时，模型会选择其中一个生成结果
parameters.name: tools
